Discussed Diwali and Makar Sankranti celebrations across India.
Kavya mentioned crackers, sweets, new clothes, bathing, til-gud, and kite flying.
Kavya identified October–November for Diwali but was unsure about the regional food and crop.
New rice, jaggery, and milk were stated later; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised describing festivals using food, clothes, timing, decorations, and activities. Kavya shared celebration details such as sweets, new clothes, til-gud, and kite flying. They were unsure about the crop and festival food, and the food details were partly clarified later in the lesson. At home, ask Kavya to describe one festival in four points: time, food, clothes, and activity.
